maddeler.e:
أتناصر (form VI)
# أَتَنَاصَرُ (ʔatanāṣaru) /ʔa.ta.naː.sˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# أَتَنَاصَرَ (ʔatanāṣara) /ʔa.ta.naː.sˤa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# أَتَنَاصَرْ (ʔatanāṣar) /ʔa.ta.naː.sˤar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
